summary: Independently verified the approved Story 2 implementation and API documentation. Focused OpenAPI checks and a clean full Maven build passed; documented endpoints, statuses, schemas, availability, and existing API behavior match the implementation.

decisions.result: Validated the completed implementation and immediate predecessor code-review handoff (completed, no findings, no blockers), and the approved Story 2 requirements, architecture, design review, and implementation plan.

BUILD SUCCESS; 3 tests run, 0 failures, 0 errors, 0 skipped. Tests verified Swagger UI HTML at /swagger-ui/index.html; OpenAPI JSON at /v3/api-docs; exact documented paths/methods; response codes; Employee, CreateEmployeeRequest, and ErrorResponse properties/types; and success/error response schema references.

BUILD SUCCESS; full suite 8 tests run, 0 failures, 0 errors, 0 skipped. The five existing API regression tests passed, covering the empty collection, unknown-ID 404 body, create and retrieval behavior/IDs, validation failures, and malformed JSON. Maven compiled the project and packaged the Spring Boot jar.

Compared docs/api-docs.md, EmployeeController mappings/annotations, and OpenApiDocumentationTests with the approved requirements. The only documented routes are GET /api/employees (200 array of Employee), GET /api/employees/{id} (200 Employee, 404 ErrorResponse), and POST /api/employees (CreateEmployeeRequest JSON, 201 Employee, 400 ErrorResponse). The OpenAPI tests assert those exact method/path and status sets, Employee fields id/name/email, request fields name/email, ErrorResponse field error, array/item and object response schemas, and the request schema. Controller annotations explicitly declare the 404/400 ErrorResponse schemas. The Markdown documents both discovery URLs, request requirements, response statuses, and corresponding examples.

Verification ran with Maven 3.9.11 and Java 17.0.20.1; the project POM specifies Spring Boot 3.5.6, Java 17, and springdoc-openapi-starter-webmvc-ui 2.8.9. Both test runs started the Spring Boot 3.5.6 application and initialized springdoc successfully. Read-only git diff --check passed. Read-only git status also listed changes to README.md, .github/hooks/validate-handoff.ps1, .sdlc/evidence/, and docs/story2.md alongside Story 2 files; attribution/baseline was not established here. No Git write operation was performed.
PASS. Approved API documentation requirements and existing behavior are verified by implementation comparison and fresh test execution. No verification blockers.
